style.common: Pixel art asset for a 2D top-down office game, clean 16-bit SNES style. STRICT PALETTE: use ONLY colors from this CC0 palette (Endesga 32): {PALETTE}. Hard-edged pixels only: no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no dithering, no blur, no glow, no drop shadow, no outline halo, no text, no watermark, no logo, no signature, no UI frame, no border. Chunky readable shapes with a low pixel count, as if authored on a {CELL} pixel canvas and then scaled up with nearest-neighbour: every art pixel is a large flat square of solid color. Orthographic, no perspective distortion, no camera tilt. Single subject, centered, filling the frame with a small even margin.
style.cutout: BACKGROUND: a single flat pure magenta #FF00FF, 100% saturated, filling every pixel that is not part of the subject, all the way to the frame edges. NEVER use magenta, pink, fuchsia or violet anywhere inside the subject itself, not even as an accent - the magenta is a chroma key that gets removed.
style.seamless: The image is a single square tile that must tile seamlessly on all four edges: the pattern running off the right edge continues exactly at the left edge, and the pattern running off the bottom edge continues exactly at the top edge. Fill the whole square edge to edge with the material - no background, no magenta, no margin, no frame, no vignette, no isolated centered object.

pieces.prompt: A seamless office floor tile seen straight from above: light grey-blue industrial carpet with a subtle two-tone weave and a faint darker seam at the edges. Very low contrast so characters and furniture stay readable on top of it. Use only the cool greys of the palette (#c0cbdc, #8b9bb4, #5a6988, #3a4466).

A straight horizontal segment of the TOP wall of an office room, seen from a fixed 2D top-down-front angle: a flat wall face of painted drywall (#5a6988 body, #8b9bb4 lit top cap, #3a4466 shadow at the base) with a thin darker baseboard line along the bottom. Tiles horizontally with its neighbours: the left and right edges must match exactly. Keep it plain - no posters, no windows, no sockets.

The TOP-LEFT outer corner piece of an office room wall, same fixed top-down-front angle and same drywall material as the reference wall segment: the wall cap turning the corner, navy structure (#262b44, #3a4466) with the same lighter top cap (#8b9bb4). It must line up pixel-perfect with the straight top wall segment on its right edge and with a vertical side wall on its bottom edge.

The TOP-RIGHT outer corner piece of the same office wall, the exact mirror counterpart of the top-left corner reference, same angle, same material and same lighting. It must line up pixel-perfect with the straight top wall segment on its left edge and with a vertical side wall on its bottom edge.

A vertical LATERAL wall segment of the same office room, seen from the same fixed 2D top-down angle: the narrow top face of a side wall running from the top to the bottom of the tile, navy core (#3a4466) with a lighter highlight strip (#8b9bb4) on one side and a darker shadow strip (#262b44) on the other. Tiles vertically: top and bottom edges must match exactly.

A straight horizontal segment of the BOTTOM wall of the same office room, same fixed 2D top-down angle: only the thin top surface of the wall is visible, navy (#3a4466) with a lighter cap line (#8b9bb4) on top and a darker shadow (#262b44) where it meets the floor below. Same material and lighting as the reference top wall. Tiles horizontally: left and right edges must match exactly.

A CLOSED office door filling a gap in the top wall, same fixed angle and same wall material as the reference: a warm wood door slab (#b86f50 body, #733e39 shadow, #e4a672 highlight) set into the navy wall frame, with a small pale handle (#c0cbdc) on the right. The door occupies the middle of the tile and the wall frame continues at the left and right edges so it lines up with the neighbouring wall segments.

The OPEN state of the exact same office door from the reference image: the wood slab is swung away, leaving a dark empty doorway (#181425, #262b44) inside the identical navy wall frame, with the door slab edge visible folded against the left jamb. Same angle, same frame pixels and same lighting as the closed version so the two can be swapped in place.

Full-body character sprite of the PO (product owner) of a small software squad, FRONT VIEW facing the camera (down-facing idle pose): head slightly oversized for a cute readable sprite, short dark hair (#181425), pale warm skin (#e8b796), round glasses (#c0cbdc), bright blue shirt (#0099db) with darker blue shading (#124e89), navy trousers (#3a4466) and dark shoes (#262b44). Arms relaxed at the sides, standing straight and symmetric, both feet flat on the ground and level with each other. The whole body is visible: the feet sit on the bottom margin of the frame and the top of the head near the top margin. No shadow under the feet, no floor, no props.

The SAME character as the reference image, now in strict SIDE VIEW facing LEFT (left-facing idle pose). Identical proportions, identical palette, identical hair, glasses, blue shirt, navy trousers and shoes - only the facing changes. One eye and one lens of the glasses visible in profile, arms at the side, both feet flat on the ground at the same height as in the reference.

The SAME character as the reference images, now in strict SIDE VIEW facing RIGHT (right-facing idle pose) - the exact mirror of the left-facing reference, with identical proportions, palette and clothing. Both feet flat on the ground at the same height as the reference.

The SAME character as the reference image, now seen from BEHIND, facing away from the camera (up-facing idle pose). Identical proportions, palette and clothing; the back of the head with the same short dark hair, no face and no glasses visible, the back of the blue shirt, arms at the sides, both feet flat on the ground at the same height as the reference.

An office desk with a monitor on it, same fixed 2D top-down-front angle as the office walls, scaled so the desktop reaches roughly the waist of the character in the reference image. A wide warm wood desktop (#c28569, #b86f50, #733e39 shadow) on two dark legs, a flat-panel monitor standing at the back of the desk with a navy bezel (#262b44) and a lit blue-cyan screen (#0099db, #2ce8f5), and a small pale keyboard (#c0cbdc) on the desktop. The desk is clearly wider than it is tall and the monitor sticks up above the desktop. No chair, no floor, nothing else on the desk.

A single office swivel chair matching the desk in the reference image, same fixed angle and lighting: navy seat and backrest (#3a4466 body, #262b44 shadow, #5a6988 highlight) seen from behind and slightly above, on a small five-star base with casters. Roughly half the width of the reference desk. No desk, no floor, no character.

A potted office plant matching the style and lighting of the desk in the reference image: a terracotta pot (#be4a2f body, #d77643 highlight, #733e39 shadow) with a leafy green plant above it (#63c74d, #3e8948, #265c42). Tall and narrow - the plant is clearly taller than it is wide. No floor, no shadow, no other objects.
